title: quizzes
description: Shape of 07_Evidence_and_Reading/Landmark_Trials/quizzes.json (and its resident Canon Quiz copy, _prototypes/canon-quiz/quizzes.json) as it exists on 2026-10-04: 79 decks (AR-01..AR-50 article decks, 29 SP-nn spine decks), 437 questions, every question 4 options with exactly one keyed. The schema lives at the repo root beside the other registries' schemas rather than beside the data because any *.schema.json is a governance path (bin/check_governance_separation.py G_SUFFIX) and 07_*/ is a content path; the two may not share a diff. Validated by bin/check_deck_card_stability.py. CARD IDENTITY IS POSITIONAL: review.html keys every SM-2 card as deck.id + '#' + index into `questions`, and review_companion_pairs.json cites cards the same way (AR-24#5) — there is no per-question id field, which is why this schema is paired with the fingerprint pin in bin/quizzes.fingerprints.json. facultyReview is declared but OPTIONAL: no question carries one today (437 of 437 missing); declaring it required would pretend the bank is attested. Counting fields (deckCount, questionCount, deck.n) are duplicated from the arrays by the generator; the validator checks they still agree, which Draft-07 cannot express.

id.description: AR-nn: a landmark-article deck (carries `art`). SP-nn: a spine deck. The id is the left half of every card id this deck emits.

art.description: Article number in the landmark-trials canon. Present on the 50 AR decks only.

n.description: Must equal questions.length; checked semantically by the validator.

audio.description: OE brief-audio file name. Absent in the source; build_deploy.py deck-aligns it into the built tools/quizzes.json by exact title, and the resident Canon Quiz snapshot carries it baked in. review.html reads d.audio.

audioDur.description: m:ss, as build_deploy.py writes it (review.html reads d.audioDur). Build-time / snapshot only.

oe.description: OE audio index the build joined on. Build-time / snapshot only.

q.description: The stem. review.html skips a card whose stem is empty but still advances the index, so an empty stem would silently retire a positional id.

o.description: 4 options on every question today; at least one keyed. Exactly one keyed is checked semantically.

fb.description: Feedback shown after answering; may be empty.

facultyReview.description: Same block the case banks carry (communication_cases.schema.json). Optional here because no card has one yet; bin/check_qbank_draft_exposure.py counts the absence.
